title: Newspaper: Economy & Business
sub: Money, markets, and companies as they appear in business pages.

cards.def:
A general rise in prices over time.
हिंदी: महँगाई / मुद्रास्फीति
examples: Present: Inflation reduces what money can buy.
Past: Inflation hit a ten-year high.
Future: Inflation will ease next quarter.
Perfect: Inflation has eaten into savings.

cards.def:
A period of economic decline.
हिंदी: आर्थिक मंदी
examples: Present: A recession raises unemployment.
Past: The recession lasted two years.
Future: A recession will hurt exports.
Perfect: The country has entered a recession.

cards.def:
Government action to boost the economy.
हिंदी: प्रोत्साहन पैकेज
examples: Present: Stimulus can restart spending.
Past: The stimulus saved many firms.
Future: A stimulus will help small businesses.
Perfect: The government has announced a stimulus.

cards.def:
Income a company or government receives.
हिंदी: राजस्व / आय
examples: Present: Revenue pays the bills.
Past: Revenue doubled last year.
Future: Revenue will exceed forecasts.
Perfect: Revenue has dropped sharply.

cards.def:
Money left after costs are paid.
हिंदी: लाभ / मुनाफ़ा
examples: Present: Profit rewards risk.
Past: The firm made record profit.
Future: Profit will grow with new products.
Perfect: Profit has fallen for two quarters.

cards.def:
Money lost when costs exceed income.
हिंदी: हानि / नुकसान
examples: Present: A loss can sink a startup.
Past: The airline posted a heavy loss.
Future: A loss will cut bonuses.
Perfect: The company has reported another loss.

cards.def:
A share of profit paid to shareholders.
हिंदी: लाभांश
examples: Present: A dividend rewards investors.
Past: The bank paid a dividend in March.
Future: The firm will pay a higher dividend.
Perfect: The company has raised its dividend.

cards.def:
A person who owns shares in a company.
हिंदी: शेयरधारक
examples: Present: A shareholder votes at meetings.
Past: Shareholders approved the merger.
Future: Shareholders will meet in June.
Perfect: Shareholders have lost confidence.

cards.def:
The joining of two companies into one.
हिंदी: विलय
examples: Present: A merger can create savings.
Past: The merger created a giant bank.
Future: The merger will close in July.
Perfect: Regulators have approved the merger.

cards.def:
To buy a company or asset.
हिंदी: अधिग्रहण करना
examples: Present: Large firms acquire startups.
Past: The company acquired its rival.
Future: It will acquire a software firm.
Perfect: The group has acquired three brands.

cards.def:
Gaining control of a company by buying its shares.
हिंदी: अधिग्रहण
examples: Present: A takeover may cost jobs.
Past: The takeover shocked investors.
Future: The takeover will be completed soon.
Perfect: The board has rejected a takeover.

cards.def:
A newly founded business, often innovative.
हिंदी: नई कंपनी / स्टार्टअप
examples: Present: A startup needs funding.
Past: The startup grew fast.
Future: The startup will launch next month.
Perfect: The startup has raised millions.

cards.def:
Money invested in new, risky businesses.
हिंदी: उद्यम पूँजी
examples: Present: Venture capital fuels innovation.
Past: Venture capital poured into the sector.
Future: Venture capital will chase AI firms.
Perfect: Venture capital has dried up.

cards.def:
A person who puts money in hoping for gain.
हिंदी: निवेशक
examples: Present: An investor studies risk.
Past: The investor sold early.
Future: Investors will watch the results.
Perfect: Investors have grown cautious.

cards.def:
A collection of investments.
हिंदी: निवेश-संग्रह
examples: Present: A portfolio spreads risk.
Past: She rebuilt her portfolio.
Future: A balanced portfolio will weather shocks.
Perfect: He has diversified his portfolio.

cards.def:
Ownership value in a company.
हिंदी: इक्विटी / हिस्सेदारी
examples: Present: Equity represents ownership.
Past: Founders gave up equity for funds.
Future: Equity will rise as the firm grows.
Perfect: The fund has increased its equity.

cards.def:
Something of value that is owned.
हिंदी: संपत्ति
examples: Present: An asset can produce income.
Past: The firm sold an asset.
Future: The asset will gain value.
Perfect: The company has acquired new assets.

cards.def:
A debt or legal obligation.
हिंदी: देनदारी
examples: Present: A liability reduces net worth.
Past: The loan became a liability.
Future: The deal will create new liabilities.
Perfect: The firm has reduced its liabilities.

cards.def:
The state of being unable to pay debts.
हिंदी: दिवालियापन
examples: Present: Bankruptcy protects debtors by law.
Past: The airline filed for bankruptcy.
Future: Bankruptcy will end the business.
Perfect: The retailer has avoided bankruptcy.

cards.def:
Unable to pay what is owed.
हिंदी: दिवालिया
examples: Present: An insolvent firm cannot pay suppliers.
Past: The bank became insolvent.
Future: The company will be insolvent without aid.
Perfect: The builder has been declared insolvent.

cards.def:
To fail to repay a loan.
हिंदी: चूक करना
examples: Present: Borrowers default when income falls.
Past: The country defaulted on its debt.
Future: Some borrowers will default.
Perfect: Several firms have defaulted.

cards.def:
Money owed.
हिंदी: कर्ज़
examples: Present: Debt can burden a family.
Past: Debt grew during the pandemic.
Future: Debt will fall with strong growth.
Perfect: The nation has accumulated heavy debt.

cards.def:
The percentage charged for borrowing money.
हिंदी: ब्याज दर
examples: Present: The interest rate affects loans.
Past: The bank raised the interest rate.
Future: The interest rate will fall in spring.
Perfect: The interest rate has doubled.

cards.def:
A loan used to buy property.
हिंदी: गृह ऋण / बंधक
examples: Present: A mortgage can last thirty years.
Past: They took a mortgage in 2015.
Future: The mortgage will be repaid by 2040.
Perfect: She has paid off her mortgage.

cards.def:
Ability to borrow money based on trust.
हिंदी: उधार / साख
examples: Present: Credit helps buyers purchase now.
Past: Credit tightened after the crisis.
Future: Credit will become cheaper.
Perfect: Banks have eased credit.

cards.def:
Relating to government money and taxes.
हिंदी: राजकोषीय
examples: Present: Fiscal policy sets taxes and spending.
Past: The fiscal year ended in March.
Future: Fiscal discipline will improve ratings.
Perfect: The state has tightened fiscal controls.

cards.def:
Relating to money supply and interest rates.
हिंदी: मौद्रिक
examples: Present: Monetary policy controls inflation.
Past: The bank changed its monetary stance.
Future: Monetary tightening will slow growth.
Perfect: Central banks have eased monetary policy.

cards.def:
A tax on imported goods.
हिंदी: आयात शुल्क
examples: Present: A tariff raises import prices.
Past: The nation imposed a tariff on steel.
Future: A tariff will protect local firms.
Perfect: Tariffs have strained relations.

cards.def:
To sell goods to other countries.
हिंदी: निर्यात करना
examples: Present: India exports software worldwide.
Past: The firm exported textiles to Europe.
Future: It will export more next year.
Perfect: The country has exported record volumes.

cards.def:
To bring goods in from abroad.
हिंदी: आयात करना
examples: Present: The country imports oil.
Past: Traders imported cars from Japan.
Future: They will import more wheat.
Perfect: The nation has imported fewer goods.

cards.def:
When imports exceed exports.
हिंदी: व्यापार घाटा
examples: Present: A trade deficit weakens the currency.
Past: The trade deficit widened in May.
Future: The trade deficit will narrow.
Perfect: The country has recorded a trade deficit.

cards.def:
The money system of a country.
हिंदी: मुद्रा
examples: Present: A strong currency lowers import costs.
Past: The currency fell sharply.
Future: The currency will recover slowly.
Perfect: The currency has lost value.

cards.def:
To reduce the official value of a currency.
हिंदी: अवमूल्यन करना
examples: Present: Governments devalue to boost exports.
Past: The country devalued its currency.
Future: Officials will devalue the currency.
Perfect: The bank has devalued the rupee.

cards.def:
To rise suddenly and strongly.
हिंदी: तेज़ी से बढ़ना
examples: Present: Prices surge in festivals.
Past: Shares surged after the news.
Future: Demand will surge in winter.
Perfect: Sales have surged this year.

cards.def:
To fall sharply and suddenly.
हिंदी: तेज़ी से गिरना
examples: Present: Markets plunge on bad news.
Past: Stocks plunged ten percent.
Future: Prices will plunge if supply rises.
Perfect: Sales have plunged.

cards.def:
Likely to change quickly and unpredictably.
हिंदी: अस्थिर
examples: Present: Oil prices are volatile.
Past: Markets were volatile last week.
Future: The market will stay volatile.
Perfect: Prices have been volatile all year.

cards.def:
Expecting prices to rise.
हिंदी: तेजी की उम्मीद वाला
examples: Present: Investors turn bullish after good news.
Past: Analysts were bullish about tech.
Future: Markets will turn bullish if rates fall.
Perfect: Traders have grown bullish.

cards.def:
Expecting prices to fall.
हिंदी: मंदी की आशंका वाला
examples: Present: Bearish investors sell shares.
Past: Analysts were bearish on retail.
Future: Sentiment will turn bearish.
Perfect: The outlook has become bearish.

cards.def:
A strong rise in prices after a fall.
हिंदी: तेज़ उछाल
examples: Present: A rally boosts confidence.
Past: The market staged a rally.
Future: A rally will follow good results.
Perfect: Stocks have enjoyed a rally.

cards.def:
A prediction of future conditions.
हिंदी: पूर्वानुमान
examples: Present: A forecast guides planning.
Past: The forecast was too optimistic.
Future: The forecast will be updated in May.
Perfect: Economists have raised their forecast.

cards.def:
Expected future prospects.
हिंदी: परिदृश्य
examples: Present: The outlook affects investment.
Past: The outlook turned negative.
Future: The outlook will improve with reforms.
Perfect: Analysts have downgraded the outlook.

cards.def:
A three-month period in a financial year.
हिंदी: तिमाही
examples: Present: Each quarter brings new results.
Past: The firm lost money in the last quarter.
Future: The next quarter will be stronger.
Perfect: Profit has grown for three quarters.

cards.def:
A twelve-month period for accounts.
हिंदी: वित्त वर्ष
examples: Present: The fiscal year runs April to March.
Past: The fiscal year ended well.
Future: The fiscal year will begin soon.
Perfect: The firm has closed its fiscal year.

cards.def:
Total sales in a period, or the rate staff leave.
हिंदी: कारोबार / आवर्त
examples: Present: Turnover shows business size.
Past: Turnover rose by ten percent.
Future: Turnover will exceed a billion.
Perfect: Staff turnover has increased.

cards.def:
The difference between cost and selling price.
हिंदी: मार्जिन
examples: Present: A thin margin leaves little room for error.
Past: Margins shrank last year.
Future: Margins will improve with scale.
Perfect: The firm has protected its margins.

cards.def:
Regular costs of running a business.
हिंदी: ऊपरी खर्च
examples: Present: Overhead includes rent and power.
Past: Overhead rose with inflation.
Future: Overhead will drop after moving.
Perfect: The firm has cut overhead.

cards.def:
A reduction in planned spending.
हिंदी: बजट कटौती
examples: Present: A budget cut can reduce services.
Past: A budget cut closed the library.
Future: A budget cut will hit schools.
Perfect: Officials have announced a budget cut.

cards.def:
Ending someone's job because of lack of work.
हिंदी: छँटनी
examples: Present: A layoff affects families.
Past: The layoff hit a thousand staff.
Future: A layoff will follow the merger.
Perfect: The company has announced layoffs.

cards.def:
No longer needed, especially in a job.
हिंदी: अनावश्यक / छँटनीग्रस्त
examples: Present: Machines make some roles redundant.
Past: He was made redundant last year.
Future: Many roles will become redundant.
Perfect: The role has been made redundant.

cards.def:
The state of having no job.
हिंदी: बेरोज़गारी
examples: Present: Unemployment hurts communities.
Past: Unemployment rose during the crisis.
Future: Unemployment will fall with growth.
Perfect: Unemployment has reached a low.

cards.def:
Payment for work, usually hourly or daily.
हिंदी: मज़दूरी
examples: Present: A fair wage supports workers.
Past: Wages rose by five percent.
Future: Wages will increase next year.
Perfect: Wages have lagged behind prices.

cards.def:
A refusal to work as a protest.
हिंदी: हड़ताल
examples: Present: A strike can halt production.
Past: Workers went on strike for a week.
Future: A strike will begin on Monday.
Perfect: Employees have called a strike.

cards.def:
An organisation protecting workers' interests.
हिंदी: यूनियन / श्रमिक संघ
examples: Present: A union negotiates pay.
Past: The union rejected the offer.
Future: The union will meet management.
Perfect: The union has won better conditions.

cards.def:
To discuss to reach an agreement.
हिंदी: बातचीत से तय करना
examples: Present: Unions negotiate wages.
Past: They negotiated a deal.
Future: Teams will negotiate terms.
Perfect: Both sides have negotiated for weeks.

cards.def:
All the people working in a company or area.
हिंदी: कार्यबल
examples: Present: A skilled workforce attracts investment.
Past: The workforce grew by ten percent.
Future: The workforce will shrink.
Perfect: The firm has expanded its workforce.

cards.def:
Output produced per worker or hour.
हिंदी: उत्पादकता
examples: Present: Productivity raises living standards.
Past: Productivity rose after automation.
Future: Productivity will improve with training.
Perfect: Productivity has stagnated.

cards.def:
The network of steps from raw material to customer.
हिंदी: आपूर्ति शृंखला
examples: Present: A supply chain links many firms.
Past: The supply chain broke down in 2020.
Future: The supply chain will recover slowly.
Perfect: Firms have rebuilt their supply chain.

cards.def:
Not enough of something.
हिंदी: कमी
examples: Present: A shortage pushes prices up.
Past: A shortage of chips hurt carmakers.
Future: A shortage will continue until spring.
Perfect: A shortage has emerged.

cards.def:
More than is needed.
हिंदी: अधिशेष
examples: Present: A surplus lowers prices.
Past: The farm produced a surplus of wheat.
Future: A surplus will be stored for winter.
Perfect: The country has built a surplus.

cards.def:
Desire and ability to buy goods.
हिंदी: माँग
examples: Present: Demand shapes prices.
Past: Demand fell during summer.
Future: Demand will rise before festivals.
Perfect: Demand has risen sharply.

cards.def:
The amount of goods available.
हिंदी: आपूर्ति
examples: Present: Supply meets demand in markets.
Past: Supply fell after floods.
Future: Supply will improve next month.
Perfect: Supply has recovered.

cards.def:
A person who buys goods or services.
हिंदी: उपभोक्ता
examples: Present: A consumer compares prices.
Past: Consumers cut spending last year.
Future: Consumers will pay more for fuel.
Perfect: Consumers have lost confidence.

cards.def:
Selling goods directly to the public.
हिंदी: खुदरा व्यापार
examples: Present: Retail depends on festivals.
Past: Retail suffered during lockdown.
Future: Retail will shift online.
Perfect: Retail has changed rapidly.

cards.def:
Selling in large quantities to retailers.
हिंदी: थोक
examples: Present: Wholesale prices are lower.
Past: Wholesale rates rose in March.
Future: Wholesale trade will resume soon.
Perfect: Wholesale prices have dropped.

cards.def:
A name and image identifying a product.
हिंदी: ब्रांड
examples: Present: A brand builds trust.
Past: The brand became a household name.
Future: The brand will launch in Asia.
Perfect: The firm has built a global brand.

cards.def:
To introduce a new product or service.
हिंदी: शुरू करना
examples: Present: Firms launch products each season.
Past: They launched an app last month.
Future: The company will launch a phone.
Perfect: The firm has launched a new service.

cards.def:
A new idea, method, or product.
हिंदी: नवाचार
examples: Present: Innovation drives growth.
Past: Innovation transformed the industry.
Future: Innovation will create new jobs.
Perfect: The sector has seen rapid innovation.

cards.def:
To change an industry drastically.
हिंदी: बाधित करना / उलट-पलट करना
examples: Present: New apps disrupt old businesses.
Past: Streaming disrupted cinemas.
Future: Electric cars will disrupt oil demand.
Perfect: Technology has disrupted banking.

cards.def:
To grow a business without losing efficiency.
हिंदी: विस्तार करना
examples: Present: Good firms scale smoothly.
Past: The startup scaled to ten cities.
Future: The firm will scale in Europe.
Perfect: The platform has scaled quickly.

cards.def:
To hire another firm to do work.
हिंदी: बाहर से काम कराना
examples: Present: Companies outsource support.
Past: The firm outsourced payroll.
Future: It will outsource manufacturing.
Perfect: Many banks have outsourced services.

cards.def:
A licence to run a business under a brand.
हिंदी: फ़्रैंचाइज़ी
examples: Present: A franchise uses a known name.
Past: He bought a franchise in 2019.
Future: The chain will sell more franchises.
Perfect: The company has franchises worldwide.

cards.def:
A person who starts and runs a business.
हिंदी: उद्यमी
examples: Present: An entrepreneur takes risks.
Past: The entrepreneur built an empire.
Future: The entrepreneur will open a new shop.
Perfect: She has become a successful entrepreneur.

cards.def:
Total control of a market by one seller.
हिंदी: एकाधिकार
examples: Present: A monopoly limits choice.
Past: The firm held a monopoly for decades.
Future: Regulators will break the monopoly.
Perfect: The company has tried to build a monopoly.

cards.def:
A rival in business.
हिंदी: प्रतिस्पर्धी
examples: Present: A competitor watches your prices.
Past: A competitor launched a cheaper model.
Future: A competitor will enter the market.
Perfect: Rivals have copied the design.

cards.def:
An official check of accounts.
हिंदी: लेखा-परीक्षण
examples: Present: An audit reveals errors.
Past: The audit found missing funds.
Future: An audit will start next week.
Perfect: Inspectors have completed the audit.

cards.def:
Crime of deceiving for money.
हिंदी: धोखाधड़ी
examples: Present: Fraud costs billions each year.
Past: The bank detected the fraud.
Future: Police will investigate the fraud.
Perfect: Authorities have uncovered fraud.

cards.def:
To steal money entrusted to you.
हिंदी: गबन करना
examples: Present: Dishonest clerks embezzle funds.
Past: He embezzled company money.
Future: Auditors will find any embezzled funds.
Perfect: The manager has embezzled millions.

cards.def:
The system of collecting taxes.
हिंदी: कराधान
examples: Present: Taxation funds public services.
Past: Taxation reform began in 2017.
Future: Taxation will become simpler.
Perfect: The state has increased taxation.

cards.def:
To avoid paying, especially illegally.
हिंदी: बचना / चोरी करना
examples: Present: Some people evade taxes.
Past: The firm evaded duties for years.
Future: Officials will catch anyone who evades tax.
Perfect: He has evaded payment.

cards.def:
A source of income for a business.
हिंदी: आय का स्रोत
examples: Present: A new stream adds stability.
Past: Ads became its main revenue stream.
Future: Subscriptions will be a revenue stream.
Perfect: The firm has found a new revenue stream.

cards.def:
Able to continue without harming resources.
हिंदी: टिकाऊ
examples: Present: Sustainable growth lasts longer.
Past: The plan was sustainable.
Future: Sustainable fashion will grow.
Perfect: The firm has adopted sustainable methods.

cards.def:
Basic systems like roads and power.
हिंदी: बुनियादी ढाँचा
examples: Present: Infrastructure supports growth.
Past: Infrastructure improved after the plan.
Future: Infrastructure will expand next year.
Perfect: The state has invested in infrastructure.

cards.def:
A formal offer to carry out work at a stated price.
हिंदी: निविदा
examples: Present: A tender invites bids.
Past: The firm won the tender.
Future: The government will issue a tender.
Perfect: Companies have submitted tenders.

cards.def:
A legal agreement.
हिंदी: अनुबंध
examples: Present: A contract protects both parties.
Past: She signed a contract in May.
Future: The contract will run for five years.
Perfect: The firm has secured a large contract.

cards.def:
To offer a price or proposal.
हिंदी: बोली लगाना
examples: Present: Firms bid for projects.
Past: Three companies bid for the road.
Future: Developers will bid next week.
Perfect: Many bidders have bid for the land.

cards.def:
A share or interest in something.
हिंदी: हिस्सेदारी
examples: Present: A stake gives influence.
Past: He sold his stake in the firm.
Future: The state will keep a stake.
Perfect: The fund has acquired a stake.

cards.def:
An estimate of how much something is worth.
हिंदी: मूल्यांकन
examples: Present: Valuation depends on growth.
Past: The valuation jumped to a billion.
Future: The valuation will rise after listing.
Perfect: Analysts have lowered the valuation.

cards.def:
Admitting a company's shares to a stock exchange.
हिंदी: सूचीबद्धता
examples: Present: A listing brings in funds.
Past: The listing raised a billion.
Future: The listing will happen in autumn.
Perfect: The firm has completed its listing.

cards.def:
A standard used for comparison.
हिंदी: मानक / कसौटी
examples: Present: A benchmark measures performance.
Past: The index acted as a benchmark.
Future: The new figure will become the benchmark.
Perfect: Analysts have set a benchmark.

cards.def:
A reduction in the speed of growth.
हिंदी: मंदी / धीमापन
examples: Present: A slowdown worries traders.
Past: A slowdown followed the crisis.
Future: A slowdown will affect jobs.
Perfect: The economy has seen a slowdown.
